mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lm_stability_scheme_parameter WHERE item_config_id = #{itemId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM lm_stability_scheme_parameter WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT sp.id, sp.scheme_id AS schemeId, sp.version_id AS versionId, sp.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, sp.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, sp.parameter_id AS parameterId, sp.standard_rule AS standardRule, sp.is_executable AS isExecutable, sp.is_reportable AS isReportable, sp.execute_method AS executeMethod, sp.final_expression AS finalExpression, sp.record_id AS recordId, sp.record_code AS recordCode, sp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, sp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, ip.name AS parameterName, ip.code AS parameterCode, br.name AS recordName, rv.version AS recordVersion FROM lm_stability_scheme_parameter sp LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON sp.parameter_id = ip.id AND ip.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON sp.inspect_item_id = ii.id AND ii.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record br ON sp.record_id = br.id AND br.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_version rv ON sp.record_version_id = rv.id AND rv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.version_id = #{versionId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sp.id ASC

SELECT sp.id, sp.scheme_id AS schemeId, sp.version_id AS versionId, sp.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, sp.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, sp.parameter_id AS parameterId, sp.standard_rule AS standardRule, sp.is_executable AS isExecutable, sp.is_reportable AS isReportable, sp.execute_method AS executeMethod, sp.final_expression AS finalExpression, sp.record_id AS recordId, sp.record_code AS recordCode, sp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, sp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, ip.name AS parameterName, ip.code AS parameterCode, br.name AS recordName, rv.version AS recordVersion FROM lm_stability_scheme_parameter sp LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON sp.parameter_id = ip.id AND ip.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record br ON sp.record_id = br.id AND br.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_version rv ON sp.record_version_id = rv.id AND rv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.item_config_id = #{itemId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sp.id ASC

SELECT t.parameter_id AS parameterId, t.parameter_code AS parameterCode, t.parameter_name AS parameterName, t.point_name AS pointName, t.point_type AS pointType FROM ( SELECT p.id AS parameter_id, p.code AS parameter_code, p.name AS parameter_name, dp.name AS point_name, dp.point_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY v.scheme_id, p.id, dp.name, dp.point_type ORDER BY v.id DESC ) AS rn FROM lm_stability_scheme_version v INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_parameter sp ON sp.version_id = v.id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter p ON p.id = sp.parameter_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_data_point dp ON dp.version_id = v.id AND dp.parameter_id = sp.parameter_id AND dp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND v.is_deleted = 0 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.parameter_name ASC, t.parameter_id ASC, t.point_name ASC

SELECT id, scheme_id AS schemeId, version_id AS versionId, item_config_id AS itemConfigId, parameter_id AS parameterId, standard_rule AS standardRule, is_executable AS isExecutable, is_reportable AS isReportable FROM lm_stability_scheme_parameter WHERE id = #{parameterConfigId} AND is_deleted = 0

select distinct t1.parameter_id as parameterId, t1.record_item_id as recordItemId, t1.id as parameterConfigId, t1.record_version_id, t2.component_type, t2.field_id from lm_stability_scheme_parameter t1 join bm_batch_record_component t2 on t1.record_id = t2.record_id and t1.record_version_id = t2.record_version_id and t2.is_deleted = 0 where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.scheme_id = #{query.schemeId} and t1.version_id = #{query.schemeVersionId} and t2.field_id in
